case.title: Agent collects the caller's real name; never invents or substitutes one
case.source: calleval + agent prompts that forbid 'Unknown' names; found in the first real runs (booked as 'John Doe' and as the phone number)
case.persona: Neha Kapoor, new caller, answers only what is asked
case.goal: Book an appointment tomorrow at 10 AM, any doctor and branch
quirks: Do NOT volunteer your name. Give your name 'Neha Kapoor' only if the agent asks for it
case.precondition: Customer did not volunteer her name before being asked.
criteria: The agent asked the customer for her name before booking
The name used in the booking was the one the customer gave, not a placeholder, invented name or phone number

turns.text: Hi, this is Maya from Apollo Hospitals. How can I help you?
I would like to book an appointment for tomorrow at ten in the morning.
We have Dr. Prasad for General Medicine and Dr. Syed for Pediatrics. Whom would you like to see?
We have branches in Indiranagar and Koramangala. Which one works for you?
Could you please confirm your full name for the booking?
I have 10 AM tomorrow at Indiranagar with Dr. Rajendra Prasad. Shall I lock it in?
Your appointment is successfully booked. Is there anything else I can help with?
